event_chain.summary: Leaked key used to mint 1.79B PLA

summary: On February 9 and 12, 2024 an attacker, suspected of using a leaked private key, minted about 1.79 billion PLA tokens (200 million then 1.59 billion) on blockchain gaming platform PlayDapp's token contract, nominally worth about $290 million, and moved them for laundering. PlayDapp moved its tokens to a new wallet, offered a $1 million white-hat reward that was rejected, asked exchanges to suspend PLA trading and froze attacker wallets.
